login.title: Sign in to rpmgr
login.codeHint: Enter the code your authenticator app shows, or one of your recovery codes.
login.wrongPassword: The e-mail address or the password is wrong.
login.wrongCode: The code is wrong or was used already. Try the next code.
login.tooMany_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
login.tooMany_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.

link.incomplete: This link is incomplete. Open the whole link you were given, or ask for a new one.

setup.title: Create the first account
setup.intro: This account becomes the Owner of the first organisation and the Instance Admin.
setup.name: Your name
setup.exists: The first account exists already. Sign in with it, or ask for a reset link.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.passwordHint: 12 to 256 characters. A passphrase of several words is easy to type and hard to guess.
reset.done: Your password is set, and your other sessions have ended. Sign in with the new password.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.sent: If an account uses this address, a reset link is on its way. It works once, for 24 hours.
forgot.noMail: This controller cannot send e-mail. Ask an Owner or the Instance Admin for a reset link.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.intro: This action needs you to confirm your identity again. You stay confirmed for a few minutes.
stepUp.wrongCode: The code is wrong or was used already. Try the next code.

account.title: Account
account.passwordChanged: Your password is changed, and your other sessions have ended.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.none: Add an authenticator app, so that signing in needs a code from your phone as well as your password.
mfa.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qr: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manual: Or enter this key by hand:
mfa.codesIntro: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once instead of a code from the app, and they are shown only now. Your other sessions have ended.
mfa.removeWarning: Removing the authenticator lets your password alone sign you in, and ends your other sessions.
mfa.required: An organisation you belong to requires two-factor authentication. Set up an authenticator to continue.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: Personal tokens for the command line and scripts. A token can do only what its scopes allow, and never more than your role.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.created: Copy the token now. It is shown only once.

scope.routes_write: routes, targets, health checks and access policies
scope.infrastructure_write: gateways, gateway groups, port pools, domains and certificates
scope.audit_read: read and export the audit log
scope.org_write: SSO, the MFA policy and the org's settings
scope.instance_admin: the instance: CA, KEK, system gateways and instance settings
